recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. FHIR-29118 is already correctly reflected in current build-scope core source; later Task.statusReason issues should be reconciled separately if selected, rather than undoing their refinements here.
issue_request: FHIR-29118 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Task. It asked to change Task.statusReason from CodeableConcept to CodeableReference so a rejected Task can link to a resource explaining the status reason, and the final resolution also required an example value set.
initial_application: Jira comments point to R5 build work in the FHIR-29118 branch and PRs. Inspecting that history shows e3205c6627 changed Task.statusReason to CodeableReference, and d23189b362 added the TaskStatusReason value set/code system plus the Task.statusReason binding reference. The current source retains those changes after later formatting and cleanup commits.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread confirms the motivating use case was a rejected prescription Task needing to point to AllergyIntolerance or a similar resource. OO Confluence minutes added the issue to the June block and later accepted the block vote 10-0-4. Later applied core issues refine the same element without reversing FHIR-29118: FHIR-50132 raises Task.statusReason cardinality to 0..*, and FHIR-54564 adds the Any/Resource target for the CodeableReference.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini actively lists task=Task, and source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml defines Task.statusReason as CodeableReference with targetProfile Resource, an example binding, and valueSet http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/task-status-reason. The referenced TaskStatusReason value set and code system are present in source/task, and no stale Task source text was found that still describes Task.statusReason as CodeableConcept.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 issue that raised Task.statusReason cardinality to 0..*, explaining why current cardinality is broader than the original R5 change.
Applied R6 issue that added the Resource/Any target to the CodeableReference and explicitly cites FHIR-29118 as the origin of the type change.
